default_dump_device.description: Default dump device (overridden by -f and TAPE environment)

dumpdates_file.description: Path to file storing dump level/date records

remote_rmt_path.description: Path to remote rmt(8) program (overridden by RMT env)

rsh_command.description: Remote shell command for remote backups (overridden by RSH env)

tape_length.description: Tape length in feet for size estimation (used with -s)

tape_density.description: Tape density in BPI (overrides end-of-media detection)

max_blocksize.description: Maximum blocksize in kilobytes per dump record (max 1024)

max_read_errors.description: Number of read errors to ignore before prompting operator

honor_nodump_level.description: Honor UF_NODUMP inode flag only for dump levels >= this
